name: Alt Text Generator
description: Adds a button to image-field widgets that generates alt text for the uploaded image via the external Alt Text Generator AI service.
project_description: Alt Text Generator adds AI-powered alt-text generation to Drupal image fields. When an image field widget renders and an image is present, the module attaches a "Generate Alt Text" button; clicking it POSTs the file id to a module route, which sends the image (base64-encoded) plus the site's API key to the external Alt Text Generator service (alttextgeneratorai.com) and writes the returned description into the field's alt input. A settings form at /admin/config/content/alt-text-generator stores the API key and a default language (34 languages supported) and displays the remaining credit balance reported by the service. The module requires a (free-tier) API key from the vendor and depends on core Image. It ships no permissions of its own, one config object (alt_text_generator.settings), one hook (hook_field_widget_single_element_form_alter), a settings form, and a controller route.
